허깅페이스 모델 저장소에서 채굴 악성코드와 백도어가 발견되어 3만 회 이상 배포된 위험 사례입니다.
레드햇 콘플럭스 CI에서 인증 탈취 및 원격 명령 실행이 가능한 고위험 보안 취약점 3건이 공개됐습니다.
클라우드 플랫폼 Northflank 침해로 고객 API 키가 유출되어 LLMJacking 공격 위험이 제기되었습니다.
더존비즈온 백업서버 침해로 거래처 정보 유출 가능성이 확인되어 금융 사기 등 피해 주의가 요구됩니다.
생성형 AI의 의료 조언을 따른 환자 사망 사고로 인해 오픈AI에 대한 법적 책임 소송이 제기됐습니다.
앤트로픽 연구진이 안전 감시를 우회하는 학습 데이터를 자동 생성하는 기술을 개발해 보안 연구에 활용했습니다.
AI 모델의 뉴런 신호를 조작해 행동을 제어하는 뉴런 스티어링 기술이 AI 안전성 확보 연구로 주목받습니다.
빅테크 기업의 AI 투자가 수익으로 이어지지 않으면서 투자 거품론이 확산되어 기술주가 급락했습니다.

warnings: 1개 수집원이 응답하지 않거나 수집을 제한했습니다. 수집 상태를 확인하세요.

CVE-2026-118636.description: **UNSUPPORTED WHEN ASSIGNED** JavaNativeMessageDecoder in the MINA 3.0 codec module calls ObjectInputStream.readObject() on frame bytes with no class filter, so an application that puts it in front of an untrusted peer is open to gadget-chain RCE. As the 3.0.0 branch is inactive, we do not plan to release a version that fixes this issue. Users are recommended to use the latest Apache MINA 2.2.X branch.
CVE-2026-118636.summary_ko: Apache MINA 3.0의 JavaNativeMessageDecoder가 클래스 필터 없이 ObjectInputStream.readObject()를 호출하여 원격 코드 실행 취약점이 발생합니다. 해당 브랜치는 비활성 상태이므로 최신 2.2.X 버전 사용이 권장됩니다.

curation.reason_ko: Apache MINA 3.0의 역직렬화 취약점으로 인한 원격 코드 실행 위험, 최신 버전으로 업데이트 필수.

CVE-2026-120209.description: AJ-Report through 1.7.1 signs share tokens with a hard-coded JWT secret, allowing attackers to forge valid Share-Tokens offline. Attackers can mint a token with reportCode 'dataSet' to access the testTransform endpoint, which passes scripts to GroovyClassLoader for unauthenticated remote code execution.
CVE-2026-120209.summary_ko: AJ-Report 1.7.1 이전 버전은 공유 토큰 생성 시 하드코딩된 JWT 비밀키를 사용합니다. 공격자가 유효한 토큰을 위조하여 원격 코드 실행 엔드포인트에 접근할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: AJ-Report의 하드코딩된 JWT 비밀키 사용으로 인한 인증 우회 및 원격 코드 실행 취약점.

CVE-2026-120189.description: A vulnerability was identified in D-Link DIR-505 1.10B02. Affected is the function save_upload_file/mp_upload_file of the file /usr/bin/tftpd of the component TFTP Upload Filename Handler. The manipulation leads to stack-based buffer overflow. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.
CVE-2026-120189.summary_ko: D-Link DIR-505 1.10B02의 TFTP 업로드 파일 이름 처리기 기능에서 스택 기반 버퍼 오버플로우 취약점이 확인되었습니다. 원격 공격을 통해 악용될 가능성이 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: D-Link DIR-505의 TFTP 파일 업로드 처리 중 발생한 스택 기반 버퍼 오버플로우 취약점.

CVE-2026-102212.description: Heap-based buffer overflow in Opengear IM72XX, CM71XX, and ACM70XX firmware versions 4.8.0 through 5.5.2 on console server appliances allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to crash the index.cgi process via a crafted multipart/form-data POST request containing an overlong Content-Disposition name field.
CVE-2026-102212.summary_ko: Opengear IM72XX, CM71XX, ACM70XX 펌웨어 4.8.0~5.5.2에서 힙 기반 버퍼 오버플로우 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 비인증 원격 공격자가 조작된 멀티파트 POST 요청으로 index.cgi 프로세스를 충돌시킬 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Opengear 콘솔 서버 펌웨어의 힙 기반 버퍼 오버플로우로 원격 프로세스 충돌 및 코드 실행 위험.

CVE-2026-120195.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in WAVLINK WL-WN579A3-A 2026-03-10-94f93d4. The impacted element is the function set_wzdgwMesh of the file /cgi-bin/adm.cgi of the component Initial Setup Wizard. The manipulation of the argument wlan_ssid leads to os command injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.
CVE-2026-120195.summary_ko: WAVLINK WL-WN579A3-A의 초기 설정 마법사 내 set_wzdgwMesh 함수에서 OS 명령어 삽입 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 원격 공격자가 wlan_ssid 인자를 조작하여 악의적인 명령을 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: WAVLINK 장비들의 운영체제 명령 주입 취약점, 원격 공격자가 임의 명령 실행 가능.

CVE-2026-120201.description: Jpom 2.10.0 through 2.11.12 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to gain super-administrator access by injecting query conditions into the JPOM-USER-TOKEN header. Attackers can send a value like 'is not null', which Hutool's Condition parser treats as an operator, then execute commands through Jpom's script features.
CVE-2026-120201.summary_ko: Jpom 2.10.0~2.11.12 버전에서 인증 우회 취약점이 발생합니다. JPOM-USER-TOKEN 헤더에 쿼리 조건을 삽입하여 관리자 권한을 획득하고 스크립트 기능을 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Jpom의 인증 우회로 인한 관리자 권한 획득 및 스크립트 실행 공격 위험.

CVE-2026-120203.description: ShowDoc 2.8.14 before 3.9.6 contains a code injection vulnerability in its Mock feature that allows authenticated users to execute shell commands through mockjs templates. Attackers can store a template via MockController::add with escaped parentheses that mockjs evaluates with eval(), then trigger it through MockController::infoByKey to run commands, as root in the official Docker image.
CVE-2026-120203.summary_ko: ShowDoc 2.8.14~3.9.6 이전 버전의 Mock 기능에서 코드 주입 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 인증된 사용자가 템플릿을 통해 셸 명령을 실행할 수 있으며, 도커 환경에서는 루트 권한 실행이 가능합니다.

curation.reason_ko: ShowDoc Mock 기능의 코드 주입 취약점으로 인증된 사용자의 원격 코드 실행 가능.

CVE-2026-120135.description: Uncontrolled Recursion vulnerability in Apache Thrift Java bindings. This issue affects Apache Thrift: before 0.24.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.24.0, which fixes the issue.
CVE-2026-120135.summary_ko: Apache Thrift Java 바인딩에서 통제되지 않은 재귀 호출 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 0.24.0 이전 버전에 영향을 미치며, 최신 버전으로 업데이트하여 해결할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Apache Thrift Java 바인딩에서 발생한 통제되지 않은 재귀 호출로 인한 서비스 거부 위험.

CVE-2026-120210.description: FFmpeg 5.0 through 9.0.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the IMF demuxer that allows attackers to open files outside the package via unvalidated ASSETMAP Path elements. Attackers can supply a crafted IMF package with '..' or absolute paths to demux local MXF files, probe file existence and size, or trigger server-side requests.
CVE-2026-120210.summary_ko: FFmpeg 5.0부터 9.0.2 버전의 IMF 디먹서(demuxer)에서 경로 탐색 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 검증되지 않은 ASSETMAP 경로 요소를 통해 공격자가 패키지 외부 파일을 열거나 로컬 파일을 탐색하고 서버 측 요청을 유발할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: FFmpeg 디먹서 및 디코더의 경로 탐색 및 초기화되지 않은 메모리 사용 취약점 다수 발견.

CVE-2026-120205.description: Thelia before 3.1.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in ForSomeCustomers::getSummary() that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts via unescaped customer names. Attackers can register with a script payload as their name that executes when administrators view related coupons, stealing CSRF tokens to create administrator accounts.
CVE-2026-120205.summary_ko: Thelia 3.1.0 이전 버전에서 저장형 교차 사이트 스크립팅(XSS) 취약점이 확인되었습니다. 고객 이름 필드에 삽입된 악성 스크립트가 관리자 페이지에서 실행되어 관리자 계정 생성에 악용될 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Thelia의 XSS 및 CSRF 취약점 다수, 관리자 계정 탈취 및 관리 기능 악용 가능.

CVE-2026-118147.description: Improper certificate validation in Visual Studio allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.
CVE-2026-118147.summary_ko: Visual Studio에서 부적절한 인증서 검증 문제가 발생합니다. 이로 인해 권한이 없는 공격자가 네트워크를 통해 스푸핑 공격을 수행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Visual Studio의 부적절한 인증서 검증으로 네트워크 상의 스푸핑 공격 가능.

CVE-2026-78188.description: WebDyne versions from 2.014 before 3.022 for Perl issue session cookies without the Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite attributes. WebDyne::Session sets its session cookie with only a name, value and path. Browsers then send the session ID over plain HTTP and with cross-site requests, and expose it to page scripts. A network attacker or an injected script can steal the session, and another site can make requests that carry it.
CVE-2026-78188.summary_ko: WebDyne 2.014~3.022 이전 버전은 세션 쿠키에 Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite 속성을 설정하지 않습니다. 이로 인해 쿠키 탈취 및 교차 사이트 요청 위조 공격에 취약합니다.

curation.reason_ko: WebDyne Perl 프레임워크의 세션 쿠키 보안 속성 누락 및 다중 웹 취약점.

CVE-2026-120208.description: libheif 1.18.0 before 1.23.3 contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in unc_decoder_mixed_interleave::processTile() that allows attackers to write out of bounds by supplying chroma components with unequal bit depths. Attackers can craft a HEIF file declaring, for example, 16-bit Cb and 8-bit Cr to trigger file-controlled heap writes past the Cr plane, potentially achieving code execution in image-processing pipelines.
CVE-2026-120208.summary_ko: libheif 1.18.0~1.23.3 이전 버전의 디코딩 과정에서 힙 기반 버퍼 오버플로우가 발생합니다. 비트 깊이가 다른 색상 성분을 포함한 HEIF 파일을 통해 범위를 벗어난 메모리 쓰기가 가능합니다.

curation.reason_ko: libheif 디코딩 과정의 힙 기반 버퍼 오버플로우로 인한 코드 실행 가능성.

CVE-2026-120191.description: A weakness has been identified in Presenton up to 0.9.11-beta. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the component API. This manipulation causes missing authentication. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. Upgrading to version 0.9.12-beta can resolve this issue. Patch name: 44c8a61122b21f17642d717b0c4d6f2c54c0f180. You should upgrade the affected component.
CVE-2026-120191.summary_ko: Presenton 0.9.11-beta 이하 버전의 API 구성 요소에서 인증 누락 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 원격에서 공격이 가능하며, 0.9.12-beta 버전으로 업그레이드하여 해결할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Presenton API 인증 누락 및 정보 노출 취약점.

CVE-2026-120251.description: imagecodecs 2026.3.6 through 2026.10.10 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in ccitt_fax4_decode_size() that allows attackers to hang the calling process by supplying a crafted CCITT Group 4 stream. Attackers can provide an 8-byte G4 stream lacking EOFB to ccittfax4_decode() or the numcodecs Ccittfax4 codec, consuming full CPU until the process is killed.
CVE-2026-120251.summary_ko: imagecodecs 2026.3.6부터 2026.10.10 버전 내 ccitt_fax4_decode_size() 함수에 무한 루프 취약점이 존재합니다. 조작된 CCITT Group 4 스트림을 통해 프로세스 리소스를 점유하고 중단시킬 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: imagecodecs 내 무한 루프 및 스택 기반 버퍼 오버플로우로 인한 서비스 중단 위험.

CVE-2026-120200.description: Nexterm through 1.2.2-BETA contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to hibernate, resume, or terminate other users' remote sessions via session lifecycle routes. Attackers who obtain a session ID can call the hibernate, resume, or DELETE connection endpoints to disrupt live SSH, RDP, VNC, or SFTP sessions.
CVE-2026-120200.summary_ko: Nexterm 1.2.2-BETA 이전 버전의 세션 관리 기능에서 승인 누락 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 인증된 사용자가 다른 사용자의 원격 세션을 강제로 중단하거나 제어할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Nexterm 세션 관리 기능의 인증 누락으로 원격 세션 강제 종료 가능.

CVE-2026-107342.description: The Kali Forms — Contact Form & Drag-and-Drop Builder WordPress plugin before 2.4.30 does not perform a capability check when its test-email handler resolves and returns a user's email address, relying only on a nonce that is available to any logged-in user, allowing authenticated users with minimal privileges (Subscriber and above) to disclose the email address of any registered user, including administrators.
CVE-2026-107342.summary_ko: Kali Forms 워드프레스 플러그인에서 권한 확인 미흡으로 인해 인증된 사용자가 관리자를 포함한 모든 사용자의 이메일 주소를 탈취할 수 있는 정보 노출 취약점이 확인되었습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Kali Forms 플러그인의 사용자 이메일 노출 및 스푸핑 취약점.

CVE-2026-113481.description: The Media Library Assistant WordPress plugin before 3.44 does not check that the requesting user is allowed to view a post before disclosing which taxonomy terms are assigned to it, allowing any authenticated user, such as a subscriber, to learn the term assignments of private attachments and posts.
CVE-2026-113481.summary_ko: Media Library Assistant 워드프레스 플러그인은 게시물 접근 권한 확인을 수행하지 않아, 인증된 사용자가 비공개 게시물이나 첨부 파일에 할당된 분류 용어를 식별할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Media Library Assistant 플러그인의 권한 미확인으로 인한 비공개 정보 노출 및 XSS 취약점.

CVE-2026-120199.description: LearnHouse before 1.1.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the assignment API that allows authenticated users to read other users' grades and submissions. Attackers can supply another user_id to the submissions grade endpoint or query submission read functions to view other students' work, grades and instructor feedback.
CVE-2026-120199.summary_ko: LearnHouse 1.1.1 이전 버전의 과제 API에서 승인 누락 취약점이 확인되었습니다. 인증된 사용자가 타인의 성적과 제출물을 조회할 수 있는 문제가 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: LearnHouse 과제 API의 권한 누락으로 타인의 성적 및 제출물 조회 가능.

CVE-2026-120204.description: DeepInfer through 0.1.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the unauthenticated /profile endpoint that allows remote attackers to create arbitrary directories via the output_dir parameter. Attackers, including cross-site GET requests from an operator's browser, can write chrome trace files to exhaust disk or inodes and use error messages as a filesystem oracle.
CVE-2026-120204.summary_ko: DeepInfer 0.1.0 버전 이하에서 경로 탐색 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 비인증 사용자가 /profile 엔드포인트를 통해 임의의 디렉토리를 생성할 수 있어 파일 시스템 공격에 악용될 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: DeepInfer /profile 엔드포인트의 경로 탐색 취약점으로 임의 디렉토리 생성 가능.

434bd3e54a256e7d730e4ff8.title_ko: NVIDIA Nemotron 오픈 모델을 활용한 대화형 스마트 홈 프로젝트 'MonsterHouse'

9af1704724f9160eb94b0ba0.title_original: S$^2$-MAS: A Society-Scale Multi-Agent Simulation Framework with a 500-Million-Persona Resource
9af1704724f9160eb94b0ba0.excerpt: arXiv:2610.27746v5 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Simulating economic responses at society scale requires decision rules that respond to household circumstances and accounting rules that track their consequences. We introduce S$^2$-MAS, a multi-agent simulation framework with a resource of 500 million synthetic household personas. It combines trainable candidate-scoring policies, reusable financial scenarios and explicit state transitions. Trained with SFT + RLCD on 2.93 million examples, YN-mini-MLX achieves 74.55% accuracy and 38.37% question-macro F1 on held-out consumer financial-choice tasks, improving on the training-question majority baseline by 2.78 and 6.21 percentage points. A completed application evaluates 12 million distinct households in two purchase-funding conditions: 24 million one-shot choices feed 288 million monthly ledger states in 3 h 59 min on 14 GPUs. Jointly increasing purchase goals and approved limits produces heterogeneous consumption, cash and repayment paths, with much of the consumption variation arising from transitions between deferral and purchase. In a separate 1,060-household retrospective consumption experiment, standalone YN-master-9B has 3.42% lower annual MAE than the deterministic fully rational benchmark, alongside a 19.7% lower predicted population mean than observed. 8d6c68c859be71cfa0444966.summary_ko: 정부가 AI 데이터센터(AIDC) 인정을 위한 전력 사용량 기준을 낮추는 등 규제를 대폭 완화하는 방향으로 하위법령을 마련하고 있다. 기존 데이터센터를 AI 전용으로 전환하는 경우도 인정받을 수 있도록 범위를 넓혀 AI 인프라 확충을 지원하려는 목적이다.

e2e8e7ccfbee3170044e3313.excerpt: 금융권에서 해킹과 개인정보 유출 사고가 잇따르는 가운데 한국은행이 외부 해커의 직원 PC 장악부터 내부시스템 침투, 정보유출까지 가정한 모의해킹에 나선다. 인공지능(AI) 활용을 위해 망 분리 방식을 개선한 업무환경이 실제 사이버 공격에도 견딜 수 있는지 검증하기 위해서다. 금융권의 망 분리 규제 완화와 보안체계 전환의 실효성을 가늠할 사례로 주목된다. 1일 금융권에 따르면 한국은행은 11월부터 12월까지 망 분리 개선 시스템에 대한 보안 취약

d32af60adf01c3f94acef7c3.summary_ko: AI 게이트웨이 도구 라이트LLM의 특정 배포 버전에 악성코드가 삽입되는 공급망 공격이 발생했습니다. 공격자는 클로드 코드 도구 사용 중 로그에 노출된 개발자 인증 토큰을 탈취해 배포 권한을 확보한 것으로 추정되며, 이용자들은 즉각적인 악성 파일 확인 및 인증정보 교체를 권고받았습니다.

1569d33197a9e172a1977052.summary_ko: 예측 시장 플랫폼 폴리마켓이 외부 모니터링 툴인 DebugBear의 스크립트가 악성 코드로 교체되면서 이용자들의 자금을 탈취당했다. 공격자는 스크립트를 통해 사용자 지갑의 서명을 요청하여 자금을 불법 인출했으며, 폴리마켓은 피해액 전액을 보상하기로 했다.

b93c4702689cd41312d5cd6d.title_ko: 아시아 정부기관 타깃 NetamLoader 악성코드 발견
b93c4702689cd41312d5cd6d.summary_ko: 아시아 내 정부기관이 사용하는 특정 윈도우 10 환경을 겨냥한 정교한 공급망 공격이 확인되었습니다. NetamLoader로 명명된 프레임워크는 AppDomainManager 주입 기술을 사용하여 정상 애플리케이션 내에서 악성코드를 실행하며, 정부용 윈도우 OS를 대상으로 공격을 수행합니다.

CVE-2026-78188.description: WebDyne versions from 2.014 before 3.022 for Perl issue session cookies without the Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite attributes. WebDyne::Session sets its session cookie with only a name, value and path. Browsers then send the session ID over plain HTTP and with cross-site requests, and expose it to page scripts. A network attacker or an injected script can steal the session, and another site can make requests that carry it.
CVE-2026-78188.summary_ko: WebDyne 2.014~3.022 이전 버전은 세션 쿠키에 Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite 속성을 설정하지 않습니다. 이로 인해 쿠키 탈취 및 교차 사이트 요청 위조 공격에 취약합니다.

CVE-2026-78189.description: WebDyne versions from 3.007 before 3.022 for Perl execute .psp files outside the document root via path traversal in the PSGI API route fallback. When a request matches no file, the PSGI handler retries it as an API route through api_filename. That keeps .. segments in the request path and only checks that the joined path starts with the document root, which a request for /../private passes. A remote attacker can run the embedded Perl in any .psp file the server can read, such as one uploaded to a directory outside the document root.

CVE-2026-78190.description: WebDyne versions from 2.014 before 3.022 for Perl reflect request parameters unescaped into form field values, allowing cross-site scripting. The textfield, password_field and filefield tags fill their value attribute from the request parameter of the same name. WEBDYNE_CGI_AUTOESCAPE, which controls escaping of these values, defaults to off. From 2.022, WebDyne::HTML::Tiny also replaced its entity_encode method with one that returns its input unchanged, so enabling WEBDYNE_CGI_AUTOESCAPE has no effect. A remote attacker can inject script into any page using these tags through a crafted link.

CVE-2026-78191.description: WebDyne versions from 2.031 before 3.022 for Perl execute files with .psp anywhere in the name as Perl pages. WebDyne decides whether to run a requested file as a page by matching its name against WEBDYNE_PSP_EXT_RE, which has no end anchor. An application that accepts uploads by checking only the final extension lets a remote attacker upload a file such as report.psp.pdf and run its embedded Perl by requesting it.

CVE-2026-78192.description: WebDyne versions from 2.022 before 3.022 for Perl disclose application source to unauthenticated clients via the viewer in the default index page. WebDyne's wrapper scripts, such as webdyne.psgi, enable the built-in index page by default. Its source viewer returns files under the document root named in the source parameter of an HTMX request, including .psp, .pm and .pl files. A remote attacker can read the application's Perl code, including the __PERL__ blocks of .psp pages and any credentials they hold.

CVE-2026-102212.description: Heap-based buffer overflow in Opengear IM72XX, CM71XX, and ACM70XX firmware versions 4.8.0 through 5.5.2 on console server appliances allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to crash the index.cgi process via a crafted multipart/form-data POST request containing an overlong Content-Disposition name field.
CVE-2026-102212.summary_ko: Opengear IM72XX, CM71XX, ACM70XX 펌웨어 4.8.0~5.5.2에서 힙 기반 버퍼 오버플로우 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 비인증 원격 공격자가 조작된 멀티파트 POST 요청으로 index.cgi 프로세스를 충돌시킬 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-120199.description: LearnHouse before 1.1.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the assignment API that allows authenticated users to read other users' grades and submissions. Attackers can supply another user_id to the submissions grade endpoint or query submission read functions to view other students' work, grades and instructor feedback.
CVE-2026-120199.summary_ko: LearnHouse 1.1.1 이전 버전의 과제 API에서 승인 누락 취약점이 확인되었습니다. 인증된 사용자가 타인의 성적과 제출물을 조회할 수 있는 문제가 있습니다.

CVE-2026-120200.description: Nexterm through 1.2.2-BETA contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to hibernate, resume, or terminate other users' remote sessions via session lifecycle routes. Attackers who obtain a session ID can call the hibernate, resume, or DELETE connection endpoints to disrupt live SSH, RDP, VNC, or SFTP sessions.
CVE-2026-120200.summary_ko: Nexterm 1.2.2-BETA 이전 버전의 세션 관리 기능에서 승인 누락 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 인증된 사용자가 다른 사용자의 원격 세션을 강제로 중단하거나 제어할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-120201.description: Jpom 2.10.0 through 2.11.12 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to gain super-administrator access by injecting query conditions into the JPOM-USER-TOKEN header. Attackers can send a value like 'is not null', which Hutool's Condition parser treats as an operator, then execute commands through Jpom's script features.
CVE-2026-120201.summary_ko: Jpom 2.10.0~2.11.12 버전에서 인증 우회 취약점이 발생합니다. JPOM-USER-TOKEN 헤더에 쿼리 조건을 삽입하여 관리자 권한을 획득하고 스크립트 기능을 실행할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-120202.description: Highflame ramparts 0.8.1 through 0.8.10 contains a security scan bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to hide malicious payloads because collect_bundle_siblings and walk_bundle_subdir skip nested directories and .pyc files. Attackers can distribute a skill bundle with an unchecked-hash .pyc under scripts/<subdir>/__pycache__/ that ramparts silently ignores, while CPython executes it when the skill runs.
CVE-2026-120202.summary_ko: Highflame ramparts 0.8.1~0.8.10 버전의 보안 검사 기능에서 우회 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 특정 디렉토리와 파일 형식을 검사에서 제외하여 악성 페이로드가 은닉될 위험이 있습니다.

CVE-2026-120203.description: ShowDoc 2.8.14 before 3.9.6 contains a code injection vulnerability in its Mock feature that allows authenticated users to execute shell commands through mockjs templates. Attackers can store a template via MockController::add with escaped parentheses that mockjs evaluates with eval(), then trigger it through MockController::infoByKey to run commands, as root in the official Docker image.
CVE-2026-120203.summary_ko: ShowDoc 2.8.14~3.9.6 이전 버전의 Mock 기능에서 코드 주입 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 인증된 사용자가 템플릿을 통해 셸 명령을 실행할 수 있으며, 도커 환경에서는 루트 권한 실행이 가능합니다.

CVE-2026-120204.description: DeepInfer through 0.1.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the unauthenticated /profile endpoint that allows remote attackers to create arbitrary directories via the output_dir parameter. Attackers, including cross-site GET requests from an operator's browser, can write chrome trace files to exhaust disk or inodes and use error messages as a filesystem oracle.
CVE-2026-120204.summary_ko: DeepInfer 0.1.0 버전 이하에서 경로 탐색 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 비인증 사용자가 /profile 엔드포인트를 통해 임의의 디렉토리를 생성할 수 있어 파일 시스템 공격에 악용될 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-120205.description: Thelia before 3.1.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in ForSomeCustomers::getSummary() that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts via unescaped customer names. Attackers can register with a script payload as their name that executes when administrators view related coupons, stealing CSRF tokens to create administrator accounts.
CVE-2026-120205.summary_ko: Thelia 3.1.0 이전 버전에서 저장형 교차 사이트 스크립팅(XSS) 취약점이 확인되었습니다. 고객 이름 필드에 삽입된 악성 스크립트가 관리자 페이지에서 실행되어 관리자 계정 생성에 악용될 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-120206.description: Thelia before 3.2.0 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the back office that allows attackers to forge administrative actions because per-session CSRF tokens leak via URL query strings. Attackers can reuse leaked tokens or target the unprotected setToggleVisibilityAction and updatePositionAction to make logged-in administrators delete, hide or reorder catalogue and configuration objects.

CVE-2026-120207.description: Thelia Page Module before 2.0.4 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows remote attackers to delete page tags, documents and images by abusing back-office delete routes lacking CSRF tokens and permission checks. Attackers can lure a logged-in administrator into navigating to crafted GET requests that walk sequential ids, removing TheliaLibrary images, their files and variants across pages, products and categories.

CVE-2026-120208.description: libheif 1.18.0 before 1.23.3 contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in unc_decoder_mixed_interleave::processTile() that allows attackers to write out of bounds by supplying chroma components with unequal bit depths. Attackers can craft a HEIF file declaring, for example, 16-bit Cb and 8-bit Cr to trigger file-controlled heap writes past the Cr plane, potentially achieving code execution in image-processing pipelines.
CVE-2026-120208.summary_ko: libheif 1.18.0~1.23.3 이전 버전의 디코딩 과정에서 힙 기반 버퍼 오버플로우가 발생합니다. 비트 깊이가 다른 색상 성분을 포함한 HEIF 파일을 통해 범위를 벗어난 메모리 쓰기가 가능합니다.

CVE-2026-120209.description: AJ-Report through 1.7.1 signs share tokens with a hard-coded JWT secret, allowing attackers to forge valid Share-Tokens offline. Attackers can mint a token with reportCode 'dataSet' to access the testTransform endpoint, which passes scripts to GroovyClassLoader for unauthenticated remote code execution.
CVE-2026-120209.summary_ko: AJ-Report 1.7.1 이전 버전은 공유 토큰 생성 시 하드코딩된 JWT 비밀키를 사용합니다. 공격자가 유효한 토큰을 위조하여 원격 코드 실행 엔드포인트에 접근할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-120210.description: FFmpeg 5.0 through 9.0.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the IMF demuxer that allows attackers to open files outside the package via unvalidated ASSETMAP Path elements. Attackers can supply a crafted IMF package with '..' or absolute paths to demux local MXF files, probe file existence and size, or trigger server-side requests.
CVE-2026-120210.summary_ko: FFmpeg 5.0부터 9.0.2 버전의 IMF 디먹서(demuxer)에서 경로 탐색 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 검증되지 않은 ASSETMAP 경로 요소를 통해 공격자가 패키지 외부 파일을 열거나 로컬 파일을 탐색하고 서버 측 요청을 유발할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-118147.description: Improper certificate validation in Visual Studio allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.
CVE-2026-118147.summary_ko: Visual Studio에서 부적절한 인증서 검증 문제가 발생합니다. 이로 인해 권한이 없는 공격자가 네트워크를 통해 스푸핑 공격을 수행할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-118636.description: **UNSUPPORTED WHEN ASSIGNED** JavaNativeMessageDecoder in the MINA 3.0 codec module calls ObjectInputStream.readObject() on frame bytes with no class filter, so an application that puts it in front of an untrusted peer is open to gadget-chain RCE. As the 3.0.0 branch is inactive, we do not plan to release a version that fixes this issue. Users are recommended to use the latest Apache MINA 2.2.X branch.
CVE-2026-118636.summary_ko: Apache MINA 3.0의 JavaNativeMessageDecoder가 클래스 필터 없이 ObjectInputStream.readObject()를 호출하여 원격 코드 실행 취약점이 발생합니다. 해당 브랜치는 비활성 상태이므로 최신 2.2.X 버전 사용이 권장됩니다.

CVE-2026-120135.description: Uncontrolled Recursion vulnerability in Apache Thrift Java bindings. This issue affects Apache Thrift: before 0.24.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.24.0, which fixes the issue.
CVE-2026-120135.summary_ko: Apache Thrift Java 바인딩에서 통제되지 않은 재귀 호출 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 0.24.0 이전 버전에 영향을 미치며, 최신 버전으로 업데이트하여 해결할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-120185.description: A security flaw has been discovered in ken678 YznCMS up to 2.2.0. The affected element is the function Backend of the file app/admin/controller/auth/Group.php of the component Auth Group Handler. Performing a manipulation results in improper privilege management. The attack can be initiated remotely. Upgrading to version 2.2.1 is sufficient to fix this issue. The patch is named ed16cd7f7f73e0316ffa8a148d. You should upgrade the affected component.

CVE-2026-115946.description: XS::libbrotli versions before 1.2.1.0 for Perl bundle a brotli library with an out-of-bounds write in the decoder. Affected versions compile a bundled brotli into static archives that dependent XS modules link against at build time, rather than using the system library. The bundled copy, 1.0.7 or 1.1.0 across the range, carries the decoder out-of-bounds write described in CVE-2026-111497. Version 1.2.1.0 updates it to brotli 1.2.1. XS::libbrotli has no Perl interface, so the decoder is reached through any dependent module that decompresses untrusted data with it. An attacker supplying a crafted brotli stream can corrupt decoder state, disclose memory, crash the process, or potentially execute arbitrary code. Upgrading the system brotli does not remediate this.

CVE-2026-120189.description: A vulnerability was identified in D-Link DIR-505 1.10B02. Affected is the function save_upload_file/mp_upload_file of the file /usr/bin/tftpd of the component TFTP Upload Filename Handler. The manipulation leads to stack-based buffer overflow. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.
CVE-2026-120189.summary_ko: D-Link DIR-505 1.10B02의 TFTP 업로드 파일 이름 처리기 기능에서 스택 기반 버퍼 오버플로우 취약점이 확인되었습니다. 원격 공격을 통해 악용될 가능성이 있습니다.

CVE-2026-120190.description: A security flaw has been discovered in PostyBirb Plus up to 3.1.75. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file ui/src/views/submissions/submission-forms/form-components/DescriptionInput.tsx of the component Submission Description Editor. The manipulation results in cross site scripting. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. Upgrading to version 3.1.76 addresses this issue. The patch is identified as 6b11c2345ad98ae59fd5404a9f1024eb1d10c8a4. It is advisable to upgrade the affected component.

CVE-2026-120191.description: A weakness has been identified in Presenton up to 0.9.11-beta. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the component API. This manipulation causes missing authentication. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. Upgrading to version 0.9.12-beta can resolve this issue. Patch name: 44c8a61122b21f17642d717b0c4d6f2c54c0f180. You should upgrade the affected component.
CVE-2026-120191.summary_ko: Presenton 0.9.11-beta 이하 버전의 API 구성 요소에서 인증 누락 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 원격에서 공격이 가능하며, 0.9.12-beta 버전으로 업그레이드하여 해결할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-120243.description: FFmpeg 2.0 through 9.0.2 contains a use of uninitialized variable vulnerability in the Go2Meeting decoder that allows attackers to leak stack memory through out-of-range palette indices. Attackers can craft a G2M3/G2M4 stream with a short Kempf palette so kempf_restore_buf() copies uninitialized stack bytes, including pointers or stack guards, into decoded output.

CVE-2026-120244.description: FFmpeg 2.1 through 9.0.2 contains a use of uninitialized resource vulnerability in the PCX decoder that allows attackers to leak heap memory through truncated RLE scanlines. Attackers can craft a PCX image whose RLE data ends early, causing pcx_decode_frame() to copy uninitialized av_malloc() buffer contents into visible decoded pixels.

CVE-2026-120245.description: FFmpeg 0.10 through 9.0.2 contains a use of uninitialized resource vulnerability in sunrast_decode_frame() that leaks heap memory when decoding truncated 1-bit and 4-bit paletted Sun Raster images. Attackers can craft a truncated Sun Raster file so the uncleared temporary bitmap is expanded into PAL8 pixels, exposing stale heap contents such as allocator words in decoded output.

CVE-2026-120246.description: FFmpeg 4.4 through 9.0.2 contains a use of uninitialized variable vulnerability in the CDXL decoder that leaks stack memory into decoded pixels via unfilled HAM palette entries. Attackers can craft a type-0 CDXL file whose HAM pixels select unfilled new_palette entries in cdxl_decode_ham8() or cdxl_decode_ham6(), exposing stack bytes and pointer fragments in the BGR24 output.

CVE-2026-120247.description: FFmpeg 2.3 through 9.0.2 contains a use of uninitialized resource vulnerability in the Huffyuv decoder that allows attackers to leak heap memory into decoded pixels via short packed-BGR bitstreams. Attackers can craft a Huffyuv BGR24/BGRA video whose entropy data ends early, causing decode_slice() to add uninitialized s->temp[0] bytes into output frames, exposing heap contents.

CVE-2026-120248.description: Thelia before 3.1.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated back-office administrators with store update permission to inject scripts by uploading unsanitized SVG logo_file or banner_file images. Attackers can upload an SVG with an onload payload served from /admin/store-media/logo or the public cache/images/store/ directory to execute scripts against visitors and higher-privileged administrators.

CVE-2026-120249.description: Thelia Back-office Default Twig Template before 1.1.1 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the /admin/product/combinations/update and /admin/product/default-price/update routes, which accept GET requests without anti-CSRF token checks. Attackers can lure a logged-in administrator into following a crafted link to rewrite product combination prices, stock, weight, EAN and sale flags, zeroing omitted prices.

CVE-2026-120250.description: OpenAlgo 1.0.0.29 before 2.0.3.1 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in utils/email_utils.py and utils/email_debug.py that disables TLS hostname and certificate checks for STARTTLS and SMTPS. Network-positioned attackers can present a forged certificate to intercept SMTP credentials and all later mail, including password-reset links.

CVE-2026-120251.description: imagecodecs 2026.3.6 through 2026.10.10 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in ccitt_fax4_decode_size() that allows attackers to hang the calling process by supplying a crafted CCITT Group 4 stream. Attackers can provide an 8-byte G4 stream lacking EOFB to ccittfax4_decode() or the numcodecs Ccittfax4 codec, consuming full CPU until the process is killed.
CVE-2026-120251.summary_ko: imagecodecs 2026.3.6부터 2026.10.10 버전 내 ccitt_fax4_decode_size() 함수에 무한 루프 취약점이 존재합니다. 조작된 CCITT Group 4 스트림을 통해 프로세스 리소스를 점유하고 중단시킬 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-120252.description: imagecodecs 2023.1.23 through 2026.10.10 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the lossless JPEG Define Huffman Table parser in decode_jpegsof3(). Attackers can supply a crafted lossless JPEG whose DHT symbol counts wrap an 8-bit sum, overflowing the 32-entry HufVal and HufSz stack arrays and crashing the calling process.

CVE-2026-120192.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in Presenton up to 0.9.11-beta. This affects an unknown part of the file /app_data of the component Desktop Authentication Middleware. Such manipulation leads to information disclosure. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. Upgrading to version 0.9.12-beta is able to mitigate this issue. The name of the patch is 44c8a61122b21f17642d717b0c4d6f2c54c0f180. The affected component should be upgraded.

CVE-2026-120195.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in WAVLINK WL-WN579A3-A 2026-03-10-94f93d4. The impacted element is the function set_wzdgwMesh of the file /cgi-bin/adm.cgi of the component Initial Setup Wizard. The manipulation of the argument wlan_ssid leads to os command injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.
CVE-2026-120195.summary_ko: WAVLINK WL-WN579A3-A의 초기 설정 마법사 내 set_wzdgwMesh 함수에서 OS 명령어 삽입 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 원격 공격자가 wlan_ssid 인자를 조작하여 악의적인 명령을 실행할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-120196.description: A vulnerability was detected in WAVLINK WN579X3-D V250402. This affects the function port_forward of the file /cgi-bin/wapi.cgi. The manipulation of the argument Name results in os command injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

CVE-2026-120197.description: A flaw has been found in WAVLINK WL-WN530HG4B M_V260724. This impacts the function port_forward of the file /cgi-bin/wapi.cgi. This manipulation of the argument Name causes os command injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

CVE-2026-107342.description: The Kali Forms — Contact Form & Drag-and-Drop Builder WordPress plugin before 2.4.30 does not perform a capability check when its test-email handler resolves and returns a user's email address, relying only on a nonce that is available to any logged-in user, allowing authenticated users with minimal privileges (Subscriber and above) to disclose the email address of any registered user, including administrators.
CVE-2026-107342.summary_ko: Kali Forms 워드프레스 플러그인에서 권한 확인 미흡으로 인해 인증된 사용자가 관리자를 포함한 모든 사용자의 이메일 주소를 탈취할 수 있는 정보 노출 취약점이 확인되었습니다.

CVE-2026-107343.description: The Kali Forms — Contact Form & Drag-and-Drop Builder WordPress plugin before 2.4.30 does not perform a capability check on its test-email handler, relying only on a nonce that is available to any logged-in user, so a low-privileged user such as a Subscriber can make the site send email to an arbitrary recipient with a spoofed sender address.

CVE-2026-113481.description: The Media Library Assistant WordPress plugin before 3.44 does not check that the requesting user is allowed to view a post before disclosing which taxonomy terms are assigned to it, allowing any authenticated user, such as a subscriber, to learn the term assignments of private attachments and posts.
CVE-2026-113481.summary_ko: Media Library Assistant 워드프레스 플러그인은 게시물 접근 권한 확인을 수행하지 않아, 인증된 사용자가 비공개 게시물이나 첨부 파일에 할당된 분류 용어를 식별할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-113482.description: The Media Library Assistant WordPress plugin before 3.44 does not escape one of its shortcode attributes before outputting it in an attribute of generated links, allowing users with the Contributor role and above to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks.

CVE-2026-118168.description: The MapPress WordPress plugin before 2.97.15 does not restrict which user's data its front-end map embed handler renders, allowing unauthenticated visitors to retrieve the email address and display name of any user on the site by enumerating user IDs.

CVE-2026-120198.description: A vulnerability has been found in WAVLINK WL-WN530BE1-A V251117. Affected is the function con_check_read_finish of the file /protocol.csp. Such manipulation of the argument group_name/IP-FROM leads to command injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

CVE-2026-120217.description: A vulnerability was detected in Delgan loguru 0.7.3. The affected element is the function AnsiParser.feed of the file loguru/_colorizer.py of the component ANSI Color-Markup Parser. Performing a manipulation results in inefficient regular expression complexity. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-120218.description: A flaw has been found in Typemill up to 2.26.0. The impacted element is the function ControllerApiImage::saveImage of the file system/typemill/Models/SvgSanitizer.php. Executing a manipulation can lead to cross site scripting. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version 2.27.0 is sufficient to resolve this issue. This patch is called 9ca43c4a7b6764c5a6ac11a2ccc099b036ee3cef. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component.

CVE-2026-112887.description: Gitea Actions task tokens authenticate to the REST API as a shared system user with a negative ID, which repository, organization, project and key filters treated as having no owner restriction, and the token carried no API scope to restrict user-scoped routes. A user who can run a workflow could use the job's token with `GET /api/v1/user/repos` to list every repository on the instance, including private repositories of other users and organizations, with their metadata. Repository contents remained protected by per-repository permission checks. System users now own nothing, and `/api/v1/user` routes other than `GET /api/v1/user` accept only individual and bot accounts.

CVE-2026-113429.description: Legacy (v1 to v3) Actions artifact uploads stored the request's `Content-Encoding` header unchecked in the column that is served as the artifact's `Content-Type` on download, and a value starting with `video/` or `audio/` also removed the sandboxing Content-Security-Policy. A user who can run an Actions job could upload an artifact that a browser renders as HTML on the Gitea origin when the direct artifact download URL is opened, and the URL is reachable anonymously on public repositories. A victim who opens the link runs the attacker's script with their own session, which for an administrator means control of the instance. Legacy uploads now store only the `gzip` marker, and the special serve headers are chosen only for valid media types.

CVE-2026-114199.description: `GET /api/v1/users/{username}/heatmap` computed the contribution heatmap with the repository access of the token owner and ignored the public-only restriction of the access token, unlike the activity feed endpoints. A holder of a user's public-only token could read contribution counts and their 15-minute time buckets that stem from that user's activity in private repositories. Repository names and contents were not disclosed. For public-only tokens the heatmap now only counts activity visible to anonymous users.

CVE-2026-116289.description: Gitea did not reject personal access tokens restricted to public resources (`public-only`) on the organization Actions runner registration-token endpoint, and the runner registered with the resulting token was not limited to public repositories. Holding only such a token with `write:organization` that belongs to an owner of a public organization, an attacker could register an organization-level runner and receive jobs of the organization's private repositories that have Actions enabled, including the workflow content, Actions secrets and variables, and a task token with access to the private repository. The issue widens what the restricted token can reach; it gives nothing beyond what the owner's full account can already do.

CVE-2026-116296.description: The API routes for releases, release assets, milestones and repository labels did not reject changes to archived repositories. A user with write access to an archived repository, or a holder of such a user's write-scoped token, could replace or delete release assets while keeping their download URLs, delete releases and tags, and create, edit or delete milestones and labels of a repository that is meant to be read-only. Changing requests on these routes now return 423 Locked for archived repositories.

CVE-2026-116474.description: The `GITEA_TOKEN` of a Gitea Actions job authenticates as the `gitea-actions` system user, and the `/api/v1/user` email and GPG key endpoints accepted that user, so a job could register an email address and a GPG key on it; without required email confirmation (the default) the address is stored as activated. Commit verification treats a key without a real owner as the instance signing key, so any user who can run a workflow job could make commits signed with their own key show as trusted and signed by the instance in every repository where they appear, including pull requests to repositories the user cannot write to. The impact is limited to the displayed signature status: enforcement such as required signed commits only checks that a signature is verified and is unaffected, and no access is gained. The `/api/v1/user` routes now reject system users.

CVE-2026-117635.description: The `/api/v1/admin` route group did not enforce the `public-only` restriction of personal access tokens. A public-only token with admin scope issued by a site administrator could therefore list private organizations and the email addresses of all users, create organizations, obtain runner registration tokens and create new site administrator accounts, the last of which persists after the token is revoked. Tokens of users who are not site administrators cannot reach these routes; public-only tokens are now rejected on the admin API.

CVE-2026-117646.description: The repositories, stars and watching tabs of user profiles and the repository list of organization home pages included private repositories for every signed-in request without checking whether the request used a personal access token restricted to public resources (`public-only`). A holder of such a token could list the private repositories visible to the token's owner, and that user's stars and watches of private repositories. The API and the profile activity tab already applied the restriction. The impact is disclosure of repository names and metadata, not of repository content.

CVE-2026-117649.description: The issue timeline API and the web issue page hid cross-reference events that point at issues the reader cannot access, but not "dependency added" and "dependency removed" events. When a readable issue had been linked as a dependency to an issue in a repository the reader cannot access, for example a private repository, any reader of the first issue, including anonymous users of a public repository, received the linked issue's current title, body, state, labels, poster and attachment names through the API, and its repository, number and title on the web page. Creating the link requires access to both issues; comments and attachment downloads of the linked issue stayed protected. Dependency events are now filtered with the same read permission check; a related exposure of unlinked attachment metadata through hidden dependency placeholders was already fixed in 28.2.0.

CVE-2026-117677.description: When parsing an uploaded Helm chart, Gitea decompressed the archive and read every tar entry while looking for `Chart.yaml` without limiting the decompressed size, and did so before the package size quota was checked; the quota only considers the compressed upload size. A user with package write access to an owner, for example their own account on an instance with open registration, could repeatedly upload small, highly compressed archives that make the server spend CPU time proportional to the decompressed size, degrading the availability of the Gitea instance. The issue does not allow code execution or data access.

CVE-2026-117685.description: The OCI registry's cross-repository blob mount checked the target package against the token's `public-only` restriction, but checked the source blob only against the full account permissions of the token owner. A `public-only` token with `write:package` scope, whose owner can read a private package and write to a public package namespace, could mount a blob of the private package into the public package. The private blob, such as a container layer, could then be downloaded by anyone through the public package.

CVE-2026-118386.description: Workflows triggered by a pull request review were read from the commit named in the review's `commit_id`, while the fork restrictions were decided by the reviewed pull request, and the commit was not checked to belong to that pull request. A user with read access to a repository could place a commit of their own in it, through a fork pull request or an AGit push, and submit a review naming that commit on a pull request whose head branch is in the same repository. On instances with a runner serving the repository, the attacker's workflow then ran without approval, received the Actions secrets of the repository and its owner, and got a `GITEA_TOKEN` with write access to the repository. Review-triggered workflows now run on the pull request head.

CVE-2026-118394.description: The OAuth2 userinfo endpoint (`/login/oauth/userinfo`) decided whether to limit the `groups` claim to public organizations by re-parsing the `Authorization` header as an OAuth2 access token instead of using the scope of the credential that authenticated the request. When a public-only OAuth2 token was sent as a query parameter or form field, or a public-only personal access token was used, that scope came back empty and the claim listed the token owner's private organizations, teams and concealed memberships. The disclosure is limited to the owner's organization and team names and memberships; no repository content is exposed. The endpoint now uses the scope of the authenticating token.

CVE-2026-118395.description: Gitea 1.27.3 stopped personal access tokens restricted to public resources (`public-only`) from creating repositories through `POST /api/v1/user/repos` and `POST /api/v1/repos/migrate`, but `POST /api/v1/org/{org}/repos`, `POST /api/v1/orgs/{org}/repos`, `POST /api/v1/orgs` and `POST /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/generate` still accepted such tokens. A holder of a public-only token with the needed write scopes could create private repositories in organizations where the token's owner may create repositories, create private organizations, and generate private repositories from templates. The token still could not read the private repositories it created.

CVE-2026-118504.description: The web interface blocks issue and pull request changes on archived repositories, but several issue routes of the REST API did not check whether the repository is archived. A user allowed to change issues of an archived repository could use the API to edit, close or delete issues, change labels and deadlines, add or delete tracked time and stopwatches, add reactions, change issue blocks, and pin issues, altering data that archiving is meant to freeze. Gitea 28.2.0 added the check to the issue edit, delete and label routes; Gitea 28.3.0 applies it to all modifying repository API requests.

CVE-2026-119441.description: `DELETE /api/v1/orgs/{org}/repos` deletes all repositories of an organization, but it did not enforce the public-only restriction of access tokens: the route only checked that the organization itself was public. A public-only token of an owner of a public organization could therefore permanently delete the organization's private repositories, which such a token must not reach. Routes that require organization ownership now reject public-only tokens.

CVE-2026-119533.description: Repository and organization project boards listed the pull requests that reference each issue on the board without checking whether the viewer can read them. When a private pull request mentions an issue on a board the viewer can open, the board revealed the private repository's path and the pull request's number, title and state, to anonymous visitors in the case of a public board. The pull request body, diff and files were not exposed. Boards now skip linked pull requests in repositories where the viewer cannot read pull requests.

CVE-2026-119625.description: The `/{username}` web route accepted personal access tokens over HTTP Basic authentication without checking their scope. A token confined to an unrelated scope, such as `read:issue`, could read its owner's private activity through the user RSS/Atom feed and the profile activity tab, and other members' activity in a private organization through the organization feed; a public-only token could list the owner's private repositories and organizations and render private profile READMEs. For a site administrator's token this applied to every account. Tokens are now accepted on this route only for feeds, which require `read:user` or `read:organization`.

CVE-2026-119627.description: The web profile and RSS/Atom feed routes of users and organizations checked only whether a signed-in viewer could see a limited-visibility owner, without considering the `public-only` restriction of the personal access token used to authenticate. Any user holding a public-only token could send it over HTTP Basic authentication to read the profile and activity feed of limited-visibility users and organizations, which are hidden from anonymous visitors and refused on the equivalent API routes. The disclosure covers existence, profile metadata and public activity; it does not grant write access.

CVE-2026-120223.description: A vulnerability was identified in Oray Pugongying X5 Pro up to 7.6.1. This impacts the function session_get of the file session.lua of the component Session ID Handler. The manipulation of the argument _user leads to insufficiently random values. The attack can be initiated remotely. The attack's complexity is rated as high. The exploitability is said to be difficult. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-120263.description: When `[oauth2_client].ACCOUNT_LINKING` is set to `auto` (not the default) and registration is enabled, the link-account sign-up form looked up the existing account to link by the user name or email submitted in the form instead of the identity asserted by the OAuth2 provider. An attacker with an account on a configured OAuth2 provider could submit another user's name, link their external identity to that Gitea account and be signed in as it without its password, including as an administrator. The link persisted for later sign-ins. Automatic linking now only happens when the existing account matches the provider's email or provider-derived user name; otherwise the account password is required.

CVE-2026-120224.description: A security flaw has been discovered in Oray Pugongying X5 Pro up to 7.6.1. Affected is the function run_apis_by_json/run_async_task of the component API Authorization. The manipulation results in improper authorization. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-120225.description: A weakness has been identified in Oray Pugongying X5 Pro up to 7.6.1. Affected by this vulnerability is the function config_restore_ex of the file /etc/openwrt_release. This manipulation of the argument filename causes relative path traversal. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-13575.description: HTTP::Session versions before 0.54 for Perl allow memcached command injection via unfiltered session ids in HTTP::Session::Store::CHI. The session id from the client's cookie reaches the CHI cache unchanged. The sibling HTTP::Session::Store::Memcached rejects ids that contain control characters, but the CHI store has no such check, and CHI does not escape keys for its memcached drivers. With a memcached driver, a CR and LF in the session id end the cache command early, and the server reads the bytes after them as further commands.

CVE-2026-120226.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in Hangzhou Xiongmai Technology P2PAPI.dll 1.3.3.32 on Windows. Affected by this issue is the function P2PAPI_Connect of the component P2P SDK. Such manipulation of the argument input as part of String leads to buffer overflow. An attack has to be approached locally. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-120227.description: A vulnerability was detected in WAVLINK WN701AE M01AE_V260105. This affects the function del_staticrule of the file static_route_setting.sh of the component ioos Web Backend. Performing a manipulation of the argument rule_name results in os command injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

CVE-2026-120306.description: Beta9 turns each shell command in a tenant image definition into a Dockerfile RUN line and executes it with Buildah on the build worker. The worker image sets BUILDAH_ISOLATION=chroot, and no buildah invocation passes --isolation, so the step only changes its filesystem root. It keeps the worker pod's PID, network, IPC, and user namespaces, runs as uid 0, and holds CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE. PID 1 in that procfs is the worker entrypoint, so /proc/1/root is the worker container's filesystem and is writable. That filesystem contains the runc, buildah, and runsc binaries the worker uses to start tenant containers, the worker's Kubernetes service account token, and the host directories mounted into the pod. Worker pods are privileged. Clip v2 layered builds are the default, so a tenant with a workspace token reaches this by submitting one image build. The read-only proof confirmed the shared namespaces, CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE, and that the worker's runc binary is visible at /proc/1/root. Fixed in worker 0.1.756: Buildah RUN steps, including the WORKDIR mkdir, use OCI isolation with private PID, IPC, and network namespaces, and tenant ARG values are passed only into the build container.

CVE-2026-120307.description: The Beta9 worker serves the sandbox file API from outside the container. getHostPathFromContainerPath turns the tenant's container path into a worker path. If the unresolved path starts with a mount destination, including the default upload mount at /tmp/.beta9, the remainder is joined onto that mount's source with filepath.Join, which cleans parent-directory segments after the prefix check. A long enough run of those segments names any absolute path on the worker. A path that matches no mount is joined onto the container root and opened in the worker's own filesystem, so an absolute symbolic link such as /var/run pointing at /run is followed against the worker root. Upload, download, stat, list, find-in-files, replace-in-files, and delete-file all call this helper. A tenant with a workspace token and one running sandbox can read, write, list, and delete files on the hosting worker as root, including files of other tenants on that machine. A read-only proof downloaded the worker pod's Kubernetes service account token through the file API for a path that did not exist inside the sandbox. In the shipped remote-node manifests that service account is bound to cluster-admin. Fixed in worker 0.1.756: sandbox file operations and workspace sync open paths with os.OpenRoot, so parent-directory and symlink lookups stay inside the container root or the mount source.

CVE-2026-120308.description: A Beta9 tenant can attach a volume when deploying a function, endpoint, or task queue. The gateway builds the host path by joining the shared volumes root, the workspace name, and the volume identifier from the stub configuration. Nothing checks that the identifier names a volume that workspace owns. Parent-directory segments in the identifier collapse the joined path to the worker's filesystem root, and the worker bind-mounts that path into the sandbox read-write unless the volume was explicitly marked read-only. A tenant with a workspace token can therefore read and write the worker's files, including other tenants' volumes stored on that machine. Confirmed against gateway 0.1.769 and worker 0.1.745. Fixed in gateway 0.1.776 and worker 0.1.756: volume identifiers and mount paths are validated before a mount is built, including for stubs saved before the check existed, and the gateway rejects a volume that does not exist or is not owned by the workspace.

CVE-2026-117680.description: Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions vulnerability in the pattern and patternProperties keywords in lud jsv allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass schema validation via a string that matches a schema regex only after heavy backtracking. JSV.Helpers.RegexExt.bounded_match?/2 runs schema regexes with a backtracking budget but calls :re.run/3 without :report_errors, so a match that exhausts the budget returns the same :nomatch as a real non-match. A key that matches a patternProperties regex is then checked against additionalProperties or not at all, and a string that matches a not subschema with a pattern is accepted. Before the budget existed, Regex.match?/2 failed the same way at Erlang's default match limit. Only schemas whose regex explores a catastrophic branch before the branch that matches are affected. The attacker controls the data, not the schema, and linear patterns never exhaust the budget. This issue affects jsv: from 0.1.0 before 0.26.2.

CVE-2026-120228.description: A flaw has been found in WAVLINK WN553X1-B V260403_2.0.0. This vulnerability affects the function sub_416D88 of the file /bin/ioos of the component ioos Service. Executing a manipulation of the argument group_id/group_name can lead to os command injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

CVE-2026-120229.description: A vulnerability has been found in WAVLINK WN553X1-B 260403_2.0.0. This issue affects the function sub_416B50 of the file /bin/ioos. The manipulation of the argument file_id leads to os command injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

8d6c68c859be71cfa0444966.title_ko: 정부, AI 데이터센터(AIDC) 인정 기준 완화 추진
8d6c68c859be71cfa0444966.summary_ko: 정부가 AI 데이터센터(AIDC) 인정을 위한 전력 사용량 기준을 낮추는 등 규제를 대폭 완화하는 방향으로 하위법령을 마련하고 있다. 기존 데이터센터를 AI 전용으로 전환하는 경우도 인정받을 수 있도록 범위를 넓혀 AI 인프라 확충을 지원하려는 목적이다.

643bbdd196e1de2d30899794.title_ko: 핀란드 경찰, 구글 AI 데이터센터 건설 부지 환경법 위반 수사 착수
643bbdd196e1de2d30899794.summary_ko: 핀란드 경찰이 구글 데이터센터 건설 과정에서 환경영향평가 전 대규모 산림을 벌채한 의혹에 대해 형사 수사를 시작했다. 환경단체들은 약 40만 그루의 나무가 훼손되었으며 야생동물 서식지 파괴 등 생태계 피해가 발생했다고 지적했다.

08845e92bc004616b7bd229b.title_ko: 국방 분야 로봇 도입 확대…기술 표준화 및 실증 과제 부상
08845e92bc004616b7bd229b.summary_ko: 국내 방산 기업들이 군의 무인체계 도입에 맞춰 자율제어 및 통합 지휘통제 기술 연구를 강화하고 있다. 군 차원에서도 로봇 실증부대 운영과 학습환경 구축을 추진 중이며, 산업계는 중소기업의 참여를 위한 기술 표준화와 모듈화가 필요하다고 강조했다.

cd5ceaf2b623c94db85b8621.title_ko: FBI, 바이낸스 64억 달러 해킹 배후로 북한 지목
cd5ceaf2b623c94db85b8621.summary_ko: 미국 FBI가 바이낸스에서 발생한 대규모 가상자산 탈취 사건의 배후로 북한 연계 조직을 공식 지목했다. 공격자들은 개발자 노트북 침해를 통해 내부 운영시스템을 악용했으며, 탈취 자금을 수천 개의 지갑으로 분산해 자동화된 방식으로 세탁한 것으로 분석된다.

eb2ad975eb383e86bf322754.title_ko: 한화엔진, 외부 서버 비인가 접근으로 개인정보 유출 가능성
eb2ad975eb383e86bf322754.summary_ko: 한화시스템ICT가 관리하는 서버에 외부 비인가 IP가 접근하여 한화엔진 임직원 및 협력업체 관계자의 개인정보 1,903건이 유출되었을 가능성이 확인되었다. 현재 구체적인 침입 경로와 실제 반출 여부에 대한 조사가 필요한 상황이다.

7e9f2780281470a7b842d5a7.title_ko: 삼성전자, 내년 TV 라인업 3단계로 개편 및 구독 서비스 강화
7e9f2780281470a7b842d5a7.summary_ko: 삼성전자가 내년부터 프리미엄 TV 라인업을 울트라, 플러스, 베이직의 3단계 구조로 직관적으로 개편한다. 기존의 복잡한 하드웨어 기술 명칭 중심에서 벗어나 제품의 가치를 강조하고 구독 서비스를 강화하는 전략으로 전환한다.

5236aa974cf651275c5e6895.title_ko: 해외송금 핀테크 모인, 외부 해킹으로 고객 개인정보 유출
5236aa974cf651275c5e6895.summary_ko: 핀테크 기업 모인이 외부 해킹 공격으로 고객의 신분증, 주민등록번호, 금융 계좌 정보 등이 포함된 증빙 서류 파일을 유출당했다. 공격자는 과거 제출된 서류에 접근했으며, 모인은 관계 당국에 신고하고 피해 구제 절차를 안내하고 있다.

c7416d4aeb55a9d96caaedc1.title_ko: 구글 제미나이 노트북, 무료 학습 교재 확대 및 AI 기능 강화
c7416d4aeb55a9d96caaedc1.summary_ko: 구글이 AI 학습 도구인 제미나이 노트북에 주요 출판사들의 교재를 무료로 추가하여 학습 지원 범위를 넓혔다. AI가 검증된 교재를 기반으로 답변과 인용을 생성하여 환각 현상을 줄이고 맞춤형 학습 가이드를 제공한다.

1569d33197a9e172a1977052.title_ko: 폴리마켓, 외부 스크립트 해킹으로 270만 달러 상당의 자금 탈취 사고 발생
1569d33197a9e172a1977052.summary_ko: 예측 시장 플랫폼 폴리마켓이 외부 모니터링 툴인 DebugBear의 스크립트가 악성 코드로 교체되면서 이용자들의 자금을 탈취당했다. 공격자는 스크립트를 통해 사용자 지갑의 서명을 요청하여 자금을 불법 인출했으며, 폴리마켓은 피해액 전액을 보상하기로 했다.

85911e70a9deead68de46564.title_ko: 케이옥션, 더존비즈온 백업 서버 침해로 인한 개인정보 유출 확인
85911e70a9deead68de46564.summary_ko: 케이옥션이 과거 협력사였던 더존비즈온의 백업 서버 침해 사고로 임직원 및 거래 관계자의 개인정보가 유출되었음을 확인했다. 서비스 계약 종료 6개월이 지났음에도 데이터가 백업 서버에 남아있던 것이 확인되어 데이터 관리의 허점이 드러났다.

a880b1cb61b4c75aa6046393.title_ko: 이재용 삼성전자 회장, 일본 반도체 패키징 거점 APL 현장 경영
a880b1cb61b4c75aa6046393.summary_ko: 이재용 회장이 일본 요코하마에 위치한 첨단 반도체 패키징 연구소 APL을 방문해 차세대 패키징 기술을 점검했다. AI 반도체 시장의 핵심 기술인 패키징 분야에서 일본의 소재·부품·장비 생태계와 협력을 강화하고 기술 경쟁력을 확보하려는 행보다.

4f96b1e78da7c12d65555eb0.title_ko: 오픈AI, 투자 유치 목표 300억달러에서 200억달러로 하향 조정
4f96b1e78da7c12d65555eb0.summary_ko: 오픈AI가 시장 상황 변화와 AI 투자 열기 둔화에 따라 신규 투자 유치 목표액을 300억달러에서 200억달러로 낮추고 기업가치 평가액도 하향 조정했습니다. 투자 부진과 함께 경쟁사 앤트로픽의 성장에 따른 자금 조달 경쟁 심화 등이 영향을 미친 것으로 분석됩니다.

b93c4702689cd41312d5cd6d.title_ko: 아시아 정부기관 타깃 NetamLoader 악성코드 발견
b93c4702689cd41312d5cd6d.summary_ko: 아시아 내 정부기관이 사용하는 특정 윈도우 10 환경을 겨냥한 정교한 공급망 공격이 확인되었습니다. NetamLoader로 명명된 프레임워크는 AppDomainManager 주입 기술을 사용하여 정상 애플리케이션 내에서 악성코드를 실행하며, 정부용 윈도우 OS를 대상으로 공격을 수행합니다.

0dd708ac4685fa2ab1ff0b38.title_ko: 금융권 외부 연계 시스템 취약점 점검 자동화 및 보안 체계 강화 시급
0dd708ac4685fa2ab1ff0b38.summary_ko: 최근 금융권의 보안 사고가 협력사 연계 시스템 등 관리 사각지대에서 발생함에 따라 취약점 점검 및 자산 식별 자동화의 필요성이 제기되었습니다. 전문가들은 망분리 완화와 AI 기반 공격에 대응하기 위한 정부의 구체적인 보안 기준 마련과 실질적 지원을 강조했습니다.

371987ea9189bd096d46507a.title_ko: 러시아 1위 통신사 MTS CEO 방한, 5G 및 6G 파트너십 모색
371987ea9189bd096d46507a.summary_ko: 러시아 최대 통신사인 MTS의 CEO가 7년 만에 방한하여 12월 열리는 행사에 참석하고 국내 주요 통신 및 장비 기업과 5G 협력을 타진할 예정입니다. 러시아 정부의 통신 규제 강화 속에서 기술력을 갖춘 한국 기업이 새로운 협력 파트너가 될 수 있을지 주목됩니다.

c795ae96c6bef54c14e4ac85.title_ko: 마음AI, 월드모델 결합 로봇 파운데이션 모델 성공률 경신
c795ae96c6bef54c14e4ac85.summary_ko: 마음AI가 로봇 파운데이션 모델에 미래 상황을 예측하는 월드모델을 결합하여 로봇 작업 성공률을 높였습니다. 해당 기술은 작업 앞뒤 맥락을 이해하고 0.5~2초 뒤 상황을 예측하게 설계되었으며, 연말까지 사람 수준의 성능 도달 및 산업 현장 적용을 목표로 합니다.

d32af60adf01c3f94acef7c3.title_ko: 라이트LLM 공식 배포판에 악성코드 삽입…AI 개발 도구 보안 주의
d32af60adf01c3f94acef7c3.summary_ko: AI 게이트웨이 도구 라이트LLM의 특정 배포 버전에 악성코드가 삽입되는 공급망 공격이 발생했습니다. 공격자는 클로드 코드 도구 사용 중 로그에 노출된 개발자 인증 토큰을 탈취해 배포 권한을 확보한 것으로 추정되며, 이용자들은 즉각적인 악성 파일 확인 및 인증정보 교체를 권고받았습니다.

6eaa61d4c41e366f88f74f96.title_original: New Android SMS of Death exploit can remotely crash unpatched phones
6eaa61d4c41e366f88f74f96.excerpt: A security researcher has released a proof-of-concept exploit for a recently patched Android vulnerability, dubbed "SMS of Death" and tracked as CVE-2026-58882, that lets attackers remotely disrupt cellular service or crash phones by sending a specially crafted text message. [...]
6eaa61d4c41e366f88f74f96.title_ko: 안드로이드 SMS 취약점 'SMS of Death' 공개, 원격 기기 충돌 유발

CVE-2026-120338.description: Prefab UI's Generative UI sandbox runs caller-supplied Python inside Pyodide, Python compiled to WebAssembly, in a Deno subprocess. The feature is documented as isolation for untrusted code, including LLM-written UI. From prefab-ui 0.14.0 through 0.20.2 the launcher starts Deno with unrestricted --allow-read, --allow-write, and --allow-net, and the runner leaves the Deno API on the JavaScript global object. Pyodide's js module proxies that global, so the Python can call Deno.readTextFileSync and Deno.writeTextFileSync. A caller who can supply the code can read and write files as the server OS user, and can persist code execution by writing a .pth file into the server virtualenv's site-packages. The usual remote path is FastMCP's GenerativeUI provider, which registers the MCP tool generate_prefab_ui and forwards that tool's code argument into this sandbox. On a FastMCP server with no authentication configured, any client who can reach the server can call the tool. With authentication, any client allowed to call tools can. Generative UI is opt-in, and the host must have Deno installed. Confirmed on prefab-ui 0.20.2. Fixed in 0.21.0: after the runtime and Prefab sources load, the runner revokes Deno read, write, and network permission before it accepts code, the process is started with --no-prompt so a permission request cannot grant them again, and bootstrap network access is limited to cdn.jsdelivr.net. The fix is commit 030f074 (pull request 538).

CVE-2026-83594.description: Memory allocation with an excessive size value in Apache Wicket. org.apache.wicket.markup.html.form.upload.resource.FileUploadToResourceField uploads files to a separately mounted resource rather than through a form, and is told the outcome afterwards over its own Ajax callback. That callback reads the request parameter filesInfo, a JSON array carrying a client file name, a size and a content type for each file, and turns it into the list of FileUploadToResourceField.UploadInfo that onUploadSuccess() receives. Nothing binds that JSON to an upload the resource performed and nothing re-derives it from the stored files, so the number of entries and every value in them are whatever the request supplied. The callback URL is rendered into the page, no prior upload is required, and both GET and POST reach it, so any client that can load the page can have the component report files that were never uploaded, without authenticating beyond whatever the page itself requires and without any user interaction. UploadInfo#get(), which the class offers as the way to obtain the bytes of an upload, allocates a byte array from UploadInfo#getSize() before it opens the file. The array is therefore sized by the number the request supplied, and the allocation happens even for a file that was never stored. One small request can cost the server close to two gigabytes of heap, and the request is trivially repeatable, so a few of them exhaust the heap for every request the Java virtual machine is serving. A size that the conversion to int turns negative instead throws NegativeArraySizeException, which the exception handler inside that method does not cover, so it escapes into the application. An application is affected where it uses FileUploadToResourceField, which is not the ordinary upload path through FileUploadField and Form and has to be extended and mounted deliberately. The allocation additionally requires the application to call UploadInfo#get() rather than reading UploadInfo#getFile() itself. Where the application denies the ENABLE action on the field through its authorization strategy, the callback is refused like any other listener. The 8.x line does not contain this component and is not affected. This issue affects Apache Wicket: from 9.14.0 through 9.24.0, from 10.0.0 through 10.11.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 9.25.0 or 10.12.0, which fix the issue.

e04a123ed9ab00dad5646a10.title_original: More Rules, Longer Lists? Benchmarking Self-Evolving Agents on a Hidden-Rule Curriculum
e04a123ed9ab00dad5646a10.excerpt: arXiv:2610.40758v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Self-evolving agents rewrite a persistent state from feedback, but it is largely untested whether this lets them learn a rule nobody told them. An agent can also pass by writing down each correction as an exception, and its list then grows with every new rule. We introduce CLR-Bench, a Curriculum of Latent Rules benchmark. Each chain adds one hidden rule per level on top of the earlier ones. A rule acts on an opaque label that stands for a named grouping published on the Web, such as the founding members of an airline alliance. The task gives one example value, practice feedback reveals one more member and one non-member, and the test checks unseen members and similar non-members. Probes certify that the base model knows the members of each grouping and does not guess it without feedback, and that the evidence identifies the grouping once labels are read as named groupings. An automated pipeline builds chains from a new data domain, and we release 20 chains over 10 domains. We evaluate six recent self-evolution methods. With the certifying model they barely learn. The best gain at most 5 points over a frozen agent and exclude only 6-12% of the unseen members from the count, fewer than the 20% reached by simply keeping the raw practice history. 951ed3ea3665235d1f0585c5.title_original: Beyond Plausible Prediction: Safety Sufficiency in Web World Models
951ed3ea3665235d1f0585c5.excerpt: arXiv:2610.40798v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Web world models increasingly predict the consequences of candidate actions before agents act, yet a plausible predicted future does not necessarily support the correct safety decision. In a matched human evaluation of 3,000 predictions from ten frozen open models, 86.1% are judged semantically plausible. However, several models exhibit highly asymmetric authorisation behaviour, combining low false-safe execution with poor recall of clarifiable ASK cases and a strong preference for BLOCK. This motivates safety sufficiency: whether a predictive interface preserves and exposes the policy-decisive information required to distinguish actions that may be EXECUTED, require clarification through ASK, or should be BLOCKED. We introduce SafeWebWorld, a benchmark for evaluating safety sufficiency across five web-safety domains through action-conditioned futures, policy-decisive evidence, and policy-conditioned decisions. Under a controlled Security-Aligned Supervised Fine-Tuning protocol, evidence preservation can improve substantially while authorisation-sensitive decisions deteriorate. To determine whether this deterioration reflects loss of authorisation-sensitive score structure or a failure of the decision readout, we introduce Latent Authorisation Recovery (LAR). e3acdd17ea7350bf09d790a8.title_original: Circumventing the Computational Hardness of Computational Arbitrage
e3acdd17ea7350bf09d790a8.excerpt: arXiv:2610.40831v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI model marketplaces host providers with heterogeneous costs and capabilities. These differences create an opportunity for computational arbitrage (Olmedo et al., 2026), in which an intermediary purchases inference from a portfolio of models and resells it to users at a profit. Beyond creating profit opportunities for the arbitrageur, computational arbitrage offers financial value to both consumers and providers and could therefore significantly influence AI model markets. While prior work empirically demonstrates the feasibility of computational arbitrage for small model pools, scaling it to large marketplaces requires arbitrage strategies that are both computationally tractable and inexpensive to identify and deploy. In this work, we formalize computational arbitrage as an allocation problem and prove that it is generally NP-hard. However, we show that the optimal allocation can be computed efficiently under a natural diminishing-returns condition on how model performance scales with inference spending. We further develop a sample-efficient method for estimating model performance from limited data, reducing the upfront cost of identifying arbitrage strategies. 4ff8bd7485225c7e190097ac.title_original: Incongruence-Aware Evaluation of Multimodal Speech Emotion Recognition in Audio Large Language Models
4ff8bd7485225c7e190097ac.excerpt: arXiv:2610.40883v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Voice-interactive large language models process both what a speaker says and how they say it, yet the two channels do not always agree. We ask whether that disagreement degrades speech emotion recognition. Mapping text and audio into a shared valence-arousal-dominance space, we convert the distance between them into a continuous, threshold-free incongruence score with a two-component Gaussian mixture, and validate the score against human judgement. We evaluate three audiocapable models on acted, conversational and spontaneous speech (eNTERFACE'05, MELD and CMU-MOSEI). With the model held constant across modalities, incongruence raises the odds of error whenever audio is present, in every corpus, after controlling for the ground-truth emotion and for distance in the feature space. Supervised classifiers trained on the same features behave in the opposite way, which suggests that the difficulty lies in how these models combine raw evidence rather than in the signal itself. Text-only effects are unreliable: swapping only the model that reads the transcript reverses their sign on one corpus. Rebuilding the score without the emotion lexicon reproduces the central result, and among six simpler alternatives it is the only label-free score that predicts error in all three corpora. Code, data tables and prompts are released.

39c34aac649da9b147008125.title_original: ChatGPT as a Surveillance Assistant? An Exploratory Case Study of AI-Assisted Surveillance Risks
39c34aac649da9b147008125.excerpt: arXiv:2610.40890v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate detailed guidance, functional code, and persuasive text at scale. As one of the most widely used consumer language model products as of 2026, ChatGPT gives broad public access to these capabilities, motivating concerns about its potential use in surveillance-related tasks. We present an exploratory case study of what potentially harmful surveillance assistance looks like in ChatGPT's public web interface. We contribute a taxonomy of seven surveillance risk categories based on prior LLM risk research and reports of deployed surveillance systems, instantiated as 110 prompts, along with a manually reviewed analysis of ChatGPT's responses. Prompts were issued using two approaches: 55 jailbreak prompts drawing on five types of elicitation strategies, and 55 plain-language direct prompts, each run alone, and if unsuccessful, again with a short fixed prefix. We find that ChatGPT provides substantive surveillance guidance for 40 of the 55 jailbreak prompts and for 33 of the 55 direct prompts without any prefix. Compliant responses also rarely included policy mentions or suggestions for privacy-preserving alternatives. We manually review every response and find that even when ChatGPT states a refusal, it may still supply detailed instructions, working code, or architectural guidance alongside brief ethical caveats.

87d85a2a7e26c7f0fb3812bf.title_original: Does Recursive Knowledge Construction Help Agents Verify Consensus Claims in Science?
87d85a2a7e26c7f0fb3812bf.excerpt: arXiv:2610.40906v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent scientific agents build knowledge recursively by retrieving evidence, constructing an intermediate state, and judging whether that state contains sufficient information. These agents are evaluated end-to-end, usually without ground truth, so the effect of each design choice is unknown. Here, we examined two design axes: (1) what the recursion builds (the state of evidence) and (2) what controls it (the judge that decides when to stop). To measure them, we defined consensus scientific claim verification and measured these effects on this task, where a system must establish a claim's consensus stance from the open literature. We built a new consensus claim dataset, ProClaim-eval, including 718 claims with SUPPORT and REFUTE gold labels from five expert-curated databases spanning molecular biology, nuclear physics, and astronomy. Our instrument, ProClaim, persists an evidence state outside the model's context, so each axis can be studied with the other held fixed. Against verification systems and general-purpose agent harnesses, ProClaim ranks among the top three, with a significant advantage over the harnesses. We found that the evidence state improves performance over in-context accumulation, and it also matters what is stored in it. 9edd905ee8e59e6f124eda66.title_original: Towards Portable Specification of the Agent Harness
9edd905ee8e59e6f124eda66.excerpt: arXiv:2610.40917v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models act only through the infrastructure that surrounds them. That infrastructure, the harness, determines what a model can accomplish and how it fails, yet it has no settled definition. To address this gap, we decompose the harness into eight functional components that can be specified and compared across systems, and we propose a portable specification framework that records which model ran in which harness. The record is needed because different harness configurations can yield several-fold differences in reported scores for the same model, and because much of an agent's attack surface lies in its harness. Existing model cards and agent cards provide release and operational information, but do not establish the sequence of effective configurations within a run. Harnesses can change between releases and between runs, and, where agents edit their own tools and configuration, within a run. Enacted AI laws contain documentation duties relevant to covered systems, subject to their respective scopes and application dates, but do not prescribe the common harness record proposed here. Therefore, the harness has to be explicitly described and specified as a versioned part of the system.

4e96163eed815173ac3ad166.title_original: Agentic World Modeling for Agent Test-time Scaling without Environment Replica
4e96163eed815173ac3ad166.excerpt: arXiv:2610.40927v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves large language model agents by sampling and selecting among multiple candidate trajectories, but common realizations assume that these trajectories can be executed in parallel.
